questions.question: Drivers must be careful when passing large vehicles. You should avoid driving beside large vehicles for long periods of time.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles have big blind spots on both sides. Do not drive beside a large vehicle for a long time. It is safer to either drop back or move ahead.

questions.question: If there is no crosswalk and you see a pedestrian crossing your lane, you should:

options.text: Make sure the pedestrian can see you before proceeding.
Stop and let the pedestrian finish crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrian finish crossing.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians in the road, even if there is no marked crosswalk.

questions.question: To be safe when crossing a railroad, you should:

options.text: Look both ways, but only when the red light is flashing.
Listen, look both ways, and then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Cross especially quickly when a train is approaching.
Quickly pass under any lowering gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Listen, look both ways, and then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Look and listen for a train from both directions before crossing. Watch for warning signals. Only proceed when you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: If you become tired while driving, the best thing to do is:

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: If you become tired while driving, stop to rest or let someone else drive. Tiredness slows your reactions and makes driving unsafe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns drivers that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: When approaching a steady red traffic light, drivers should:

options.text: Drive through the intersection if there is no crossing traffic.
Continue driving, as they have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.

questions.explanation: A steady red light means you must come to a complete stop. Driving through a red light is illegal and dangerous. You may turn right on red only if a sign does not prohibit it.

questions.question: Drivers who eat and drink while driving:

options.text: Are better drivers because they are not hungry.

questions.explanation: Eating, drinking, or smoking while driving takes your hands off the wheel and your eyes off the road. This makes it hard to stay in your lane and control your vehicle.

questions.question: To prevent yourself from becoming an aggressive driver:

options.text: Drive above the posted speed limit.
Tailgate the driver in front of you.

questions.explanation: Relax and focus on driving. Do not take other drivers' actions personally. Plan realistic travel times, drive at posted speeds, and be patient with other drivers.

questions.question: This sign tells you that:

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions directly ahead. This sign warns you about an upcoming winding road.

questions.question: If you begin to feel tired while driving, the best thing to do is:
questions.explanation: Driving while tired is as dangerous as driving under the influence of alcohol. If you feel tired, stop driving.

questions.question: Only vehicles with special disability plates or parking placards may park in spaces marked for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: A parking space marked "Reserved Parking for Persons with Disabilities" can only be used by vehicles with disability license plates or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: Drivers who drink alcohol before driving:

options.text: Always know the risks they take.
Cannot control their body, mind, or vehicle properly.
Are better drivers because they drive more carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cannot control their body, mind, or vehicle properly.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your judgment, vision, focus, and reaction time. It is never safe to drink any amount of alcohol before driving.

questions.question: You should change lanes:

options.text: When a car is in your blind spot.

questions.explanation: Always change lanes slowly and carefully. Only change lanes when you need to. Each lane change increases your chance of an accident.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle when:

options.text: You are on a hill or curve.
There is a solid yellow line next to your lane.
There is a broken yellow line next to your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a broken yellow line next to your lane.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line means you can cross it to change lanes. A solid yellow line means you cannot pass. Only pass when it is safe.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: You must yield to children playing in the street.
questions.explanation: You must drive carefully where children are present. Slow down near schools, playgrounds, and homes.

questions.question: What can reduce road rage?

options.text: Talk on your cell phone while driving.

questions.explanation: To prevent road rage, follow all traffic laws and signals. Always signal before changing lanes.

questions.question: Before changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Turn your head quickly to check for other vehicles.

questions.explanation: Check both mirrors for traffic behind you. Then turn your head to check your blind spot before moving into the other lane.

questions.question: You must yield to a pedestrian with a white cane or guide dog:

options.text: Only when the guide dog is leading them across the street.
Only if a crossing guard is present.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians with guide dogs or white canes must have the right-of-way at all times.

questions.question: Smoking or preparing to smoke while driving:
questions.explanation: Smoking while driving is dangerous because it takes your hands off the wheel and your eyes off the road.

questions.question: Why should you not stop suddenly in front of large trucks and buses?

options.text: Small vehicle drivers cannot see large trucks and buses in their rearview mirrors.
Large trucks and buses need more distance to stop because of their size and weight.
Large trucks and buses travel faster than small vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Large trucks and buses need more distance to stop because of their size and weight.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles take longer to stop than smaller vehicles. If you stop suddenly in front of a large vehicle, the driver may not be able to stop in time and could hit you.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect your driving?

options.text: It makes you feel overly confident.

questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time, hurts your coordination, and makes it hard to judge distance. Your vision also gets worse.

questions.question: What can hurt a person's ability to drive?
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires a driver to be in good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs, and drowsiness can all hurt your ability to drive safely.

questions.question: When a curb is painted ____, it means no parking in a fire zone.
questions.explanation: Painted curbs show parking rules. A red curb means you cannot park there because it is a fire zone.

questions.question: What should a driver do if pedestrians are in a crosswalk ahead?

options.text: Keep going. You have the right-of-way.
Wait for the pedestrians to cross.
Turn right and go around them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for the pedestrians to cross.
questions.explanation: You must let pedestrians cross in a crosswalk. Wait until they finish crossing before you drive through the intersection.
